subject.title: Gemini web search hardcodes gemini-2.5-flash (404 "no longer available to new users") with no config override

question: Should Gemini web search retain `gemini-2.5-flash` as its fallback, or move to a live-verified rolling Google model while preserving the existing direct `webSearch.model` override?
rationale: Google model availability is provider-controlled and the default affects existing provider behavior; source inspection establishes the configuration shape but cannot select a safe long-term default without maintainer intent and live API evidence.

options.title: Adopt a verified rolling fallback
options.body: Live-test a current Google rolling model on a new API key, make it the fallback, and retain the existing direct override for explicit pinning.

options.title: Keep the current fallback
options.body: Leave the fallback unchanged and document the supported direct override, accepting that affected new keys must be configured manually.

options.title: Use a configured provider model
options.body: Define and document an inheritance rule from the user's Google provider model instead of selecting a separate web-search default.

recommendation.title: Adopt a verified rolling fallback
recommendation.body: Live-test a current Google rolling model on a new API key, make it the fallback, and retain the existing direct override for explicit pinning.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this person as the most directly connected prior reporter for the exact default-model behavior; repository ownership evidence was not available in the read-only inspection.
